einzeiler: Revisiting the 90s aesthetic through the HGTV show Totally 90s House
kurzfassung: Wilfred L. and Ryder Strong explore the HGTV reality series Totally 90s House, hosted by Jaleel White. Two teams of 90s television stars compete to modernize homes while keeping a nostalgic nod to the decade. The hosts discuss design trends like pickled wood and glass block while sharing personal memories from their own era in television.
stichpunkte: Discussion of the HGTV reality show Totally 90s House hosted by Jaleel White
Teams of 90s stars compete to renovate houses stuck in the decade
Analysis of signature 90s interior design trends including pickled oak and glass block
Memories of early 90s technology, gadgets, and video games
Comparison of the two competing houses and their initial renovation plans
Evaluation of kitchen remodeling challenges and final judging results

clips.hook: A very expensive 4-inch portable DVD player
clips.text: One of the hosts recalls purchasing an early portable DVD player with a tiny screen for over a thousand dollars.

clips.hook: A unique bathroom covered in mirrors and suit material
clips.text: A host describes a bizarre bathroom in his former house featuring walls lined with pinstripe suit material and reflective metal.

clips.hook: Comforters that match the couch and soda cups
clips.text: The hosts marvel at a bedroom where the comforter pattern matches the sofa and resembles disposable cold drink cups.

clips.hook: Driving a massive TV across the country in a U-Haul
clips.text: A host shares the extreme effort of transporting an expensive, heavy projection television across state lines.

clips.hook: Locked out of a bedroom for being covered in salamanders
clips.text: Two brothers recount a childhood memory involving a creek, amphibians, and a refusal to share a bed.

beschreibung:
HGTV has challenged a bunch of ‘90s TV stars to renovate a home, and we can’t think of anyone more appropriate to recap the season than the kings of TGIF!

Will and Rider dig into an all-new reality TV challenge, working with glass blocks, scalloped sinks, colored toilets and huge bathtubs.

A first look at the homes leaves our hosts wondering if some are just beyond saving, even if it is their real-life friends competing to win.

So come along as Will and Rider evaluate challenges in the kitchen, the rumpus room, and backyard/sideyard! It's Pod Meets Twirl’d: Thank God It’s Fixed with two ‘90s stars who were NOT asked to be on the show!!
